migration_gate.rule: At least two distinct new instances: L>=.01, mean(log DROP/KEEP)<=log(.9), KEEP worse in >=3/4 future pairs.
migration_gate.interpretation: Research-stage gate only; not a global effect confirmation or online policy qualification.

statistical_scope: Prospective frozen estimands on selected eligible states; condition/dimension strata fixed; 4 paired continuations per state.
bootstrap: 2000 stratified instance resamples; fresh within-state paired continuation and local-reference resamples; thresholds recomputed each replicate.
